title: Task-Aware Harness Provisioning for LLM Agents in Mission-Critical Infrastructure Operations
title_zh: 面向关键任务基础设施运维中 LLM Agents 的任务感知型 Harness 配置
abstract_en: LLM agents have been widely adopted to operate mission-critical infrastructure (MCI). These agents normally rely on a harness that determines what information they can access, which tools they can use, and what actions they can take. Existing systems often expose the same comprehensive harness to every task, which may not be necessary and cause resource wastes. In this paper, we focus on the identification of optimal harness configurations, and view it as a resource-matching problem between what each task requires and what the harness provides. To measure this match, we classify MCI tasks based on the mathematical representation of the underlying system and rank harness configurations by the amount and type of information they provide. We then construct task-to-harness mappings from two sources: mining research literature and measuring controlled agent execution. Leveraging the measured mapping, we propose a new harness provisioning algorithm: map-guided escalation. It begins with a task-specific harness and expands to full provision only after a failed self-check. We evaluate our method in two representative MCI tasks: in liquid cooling, it improves the agent accuracy from 0.652 under full provision to 0.715 and achieves accuracy comparable to Reflexion with 48% fewer tokens; In power grids, full provision remains accuracy-optimal, while map-based provisioning offers lower-cost alternatives. These findings show that harness provisioning follows a domain-dependent accuracy-cost Pareto frontier rather than a universal optimum.
abstract_zh: LLM Agents 已被广泛用于关键任务基础设施（mission-critical infrastructure，MCI）的运维。这类 Agent 通常依赖 Harness（运行支撑框架）来确定可访问的信息、可调用的工具以及可执行的操作。现有系统往往为所有任务提供同一套完备 Harness，但这种方式并非总有必要，还可能造成资源浪费。本文聚焦于最优 Harness 配置的识别，并将其建模为任务需求与 Harness 供给之间的资源匹配问题。为衡量匹配程度，作者根据底层系统的数学表示对 MCI 任务进行分类，并依据所提供信息的数量与类型对 Harness 配置进行排序。随后，作者通过挖掘研究文献和开展受控 Agent 执行实验，构建任务到 Harness 的映射。在此基础上，本文提出新的 Harness 配置算法 map-guided escalation：首先为任务提供专用 Harness，仅当自检失败后才逐步扩展至完整配置。实验覆盖液冷和电网两类代表性 MCI 任务。在液冷任务中，该方法将 Agent 准确率从完整配置下的 0.652 提升至 0.715，并以减少 48% token 的代价达到与 Reflexion 相当的准确率；在电网任务中，完整配置仍具有最高准确率，但基于映射的配置可提供成本更低的替代方案。结果表明，Harness 配置不存在通用最优解，而是呈现与领域相关的准确率—成本 Pareto 前沿。
key_points_zh: 将 Harness 配置形式化为任务资源需求与信息、工具及操作能力供给之间的匹配问题。
依据底层系统的数学表示分类 MCI 任务，并按信息数量和类型对 Harness 配置进行分级。
结合文献挖掘与受控 Agent 执行实验，构建可测量的任务到 Harness 映射。
提出 map-guided escalation：从任务专用 Harness 起步，仅在自检失败后升级至完整配置。
液冷任务中准确率由 0.652 提升至 0.715，并较 Reflexion 节省 48% token；电网任务则显示完整配置仍最准确，说明最优权衡具有领域依赖性。

llm_assessment.comment: Task-aware harness provisioning is a useful orchestration pattern, although the evidence and configuration taxonomy remain tied to infrastructure operations.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 任务感知的框架配置是一种有用的编排模式，但其证据和配置分类仍较依赖基础设施运维场景。
